_comment: Keys starting with _ are ignored. Use kebab-case; the script converts to snake_case for 8.2/8.3 ISOs.

global._root-password: Plain text here is hashed to root-password-hashed automatically on 8.3+ ISOs.

disk-setup._disks: Or replace disk-list with a udev filter, e.g. "filter": { "ID_MODEL": "Samsung*" }
